<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex054022026-02-1912-28-06" status="finalized">'o na dbang shes lnga dus 1 la <lb edRef="inst:5990" n="12a8"/> 'gags pa'i rjes su de lnga skye na rgyud du ma dang | mi skye na rgyu'i <lb edRef="inst:4943" n="14b2"/> rjes su <expan>'bras bu</expan> mi byed par 'gyur na <rs type="work" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3772">rnaM 'grel</rs> <app><lem wit="inst:5900">las ¦</lem><rdg wit="inst:4943">las</rdg><rdg wit="inst:5990">las ¦</rdg></app>  
         <lg><l>de dag 'phel dang 'grib pa las ||</l>
         <l>'phel dang 'grib pa thob par 'gyur <app><lem wit="inst:4943">||</lem><rdg wit="inst:4943">||</rdg><rdg wit="inst:5990">¦</rdg></app></l></lg>
         zhes bshad pa dang <expan>'gal lo</expan> zhe na | <pb edRef="inst:5990" n="12b"/><lb edRef="inst:5990" n="12b1"/>  
         
         <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:unnamed_reference" ref="db:3831">kha 1</rs> <note type="gloss"><rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3831">phya</rs><note type="editorial">Identfication of phya only in ID:5990 as gloss</note></note> yid kyi dbang po dang gang tshogs pa de'i yid kyi <expan>mngon sum</expan> skye'o zer ba dang | <lb edRef="inst:4943" n="14b3"/> <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:unnamed_reference" ref="db:3839">kha 1</rs> <note type="gloss"><rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3839">nag</rs><note type="editorial">Identfication of nag only in ID:5990 as gloss. Tentative identification as gTsang nag pa (ID:3839), but could also stand for sKyel nag (ID:4020)</note></note> du ma skye'ang rgyud du mar mi 'gyur <app><lem wit="inst:5900">te |</lem><rdg wit="inst:4943">ste |</rdg><rdg wit="inst:5990">te |</rdg></app> rmi laM dang 'jigs sogs <app><lem wit="inst:4943">goMs</lem><rdg wit="inst:4943">goMs</rdg><rdg wit="inst:5990">‹goms›</rdg></app> pa'i yul gyi ngo bo la yid gsal snang skyes pa na khyad par la mi <lb edRef="inst:5990" n="12b2"/> gsal ba'i rtog pa 'jug pas yid rtog bcas rtog <expan>med</expan> dus 1 la skyes kyang rgyud <expan>2 su</expan> <lb edRef="inst:4943" n="14b4"/> mi 'gyur ba <expan>bzhin no</expan> zer ba dang | yang <expan>mtshan nyid</expan> bdag rkyen tha mal pa'i yid las skyes shing rtog bral ma 'khrul ba zhes bya ba dang | <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:unnamed_reference" ref="db:3786">kha 1</rs> <note type="gloss"><rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3786">rngog</rs><note type="editorial">Identfication of rngog only in ID:5990 as gloss</note></note> <lb edRef="inst:5990" n="12b3"/> dbang po'i <expan>mngon sum</expan> dang bsdoMs <app><lem wit="inst:4943">nas</lem><rdg wit="inst:4943">nas</rdg><rdg wit="inst:5990">‹nas›</rdg></app> sgro 'dogs gcod do zer ba <pb edRef="inst:7423" n="21"/> dang | <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3780"><expan>slob dpon</expan> chos mchog</rs> <lb edRef="inst:4943" n="14b5"/> 'phags pa la tshad ma yin gyi tshu rol mthong ba la ma <expan>yin no</expan> {zha} zer ba <expan>la sogs</expan> pa'i rnaM gzhag du ma byas pa{'a} de dag ni don <expan>med</expan> de 'di tshad mas <lb edRef="inst:5990" n="12b4"/> ma grub pas gzhi <expan>med</expan> par khyad par la <app><lem wit="inst:5900">dpyod</lem><rdg wit="inst:4943">dpyad</rdg><rdg wit="inst:5990">dpyod</rdg></app> pa mi 'thad pa'i phyir ro ||</seg></TEI>
